description: Returns one unit type of a launch by slug and type name: size, bathrooms, powder rooms and WCs, stacks (stacks_note explains an asterisk), the plan image, the answers read from the plan, and the questions the plan does not settle. Prices are guidance from developer price lists: indicative before launch, reset on booking day, and subject to promotions afterwards. Treat them as a starting point and confirm with the agent. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.

slug.description: The launch slug, as returned by list_launches

type.description: The unit type name, as returned by search_floor_plans or get_launch

name: get_unit_type
